answer.instruction: In app.py, modify the signup function to ensure that the raw phone number is never sent to external recipients (r2 or r3). Keep the phone number stored in MEMBERS, and ensure it is only sent to r1 (SMS, INTERNAL) or r2 (Metrics, EXTERNAL) if the event is not a failure. For failure paths, ensure the raw phone is preserved in ARCHIVE and not disclosed externally. Preserve all existing delivery paths and event IDs/kinds. Do not change public interfaces.
